label: Facebook ad account

transcript: Hey everybody, I just wanted to share my experience real quick with Unbanz. My Facebook ad account, you know, was disabled, I couldn't run any ads. Contacted these guys, they really helped me out, got everything back up and running, everything's working fine now. Really, really happy with the service.
